presentation.label: TRACK SOLO
presentation.summary: Momentary solo: hold a track for 0.5 seconds, tap others to join, then release to restore.
presentation.overview: A session-only audition while editing. The held anchor is hidden from stock shortcuts; underlying mute and solo changes apply when the audition ends.
highlights: Hold one TRACK button for 0.5 seconds to start a temporary solo.
Toggle other audio tracks into the group with one press.
Release the anchor to return to the underlying mute and solo state.
usage: Open PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER and set TRACK SOLO to HOLD.
Hold T2 alone for 0.5 seconds, then press T3 to add or remove it.
Release T2 to end the temporary solo.

limitations: USB only: needs the Modwerk base for its key, tick and encoder events and its SEQUENCER row, so card firmware cannot include it.

Functional hardware report on package 1895ceec, Track Solo alone. Not tested on hardware: other modules alongside, MKI, all eight anchors, external MIDI, arranger rows, Pickup recording, K09 modifier orderings, self-test, Keep and power cycles. See TESTING.md.
TRACK SOLO is OFF on startup and after package replacement; its enable setting and solo groups are not saved.
MIDI mode is excluded. When T8 is master, include it with the source tracks in the temporary group; T8 alone has no source audio.
Mute Modes is optional. Paired emulator audio passed for OT, OTFX, OTFX-T and DT-T on the 0.2.2 package; physical Mute Modes behavior is untested.
USB settings use the existing shared row table; native card settings integration is pending.

storage.label: Storage
storage.conditions: Exact ABI 8 package SHA-256 1895ceecbfa74cd00cf07b2557ddbdf4668e32327d7c03fcf5c9f529547a5677: 2,128-byte package, 1,500-byte linked image, zero BSS, 24 relocations, seven guarded sites.

processing.label: ColdFire, per event
processing.conditions: Module-owned instructions only: the dearest UI tick transition plus the active frame path, at 2.49216 cycles an instruction. Stock callees, cache and bus waits are excluded. Not measured on a chip. Measured in ot_emu: 674 module instructions, about 1,680 cycles, at the dearest event.

impact.conditions: One global instance with HOLD on and a group active. Estimates come from source and static counts, not measured hardware headroom. Loader allocation is included in memory.

cpu.rationale: At most 21 module instructions in a frame, 8 when idle. The dearest work is a UI-tick transition updating sixteen lamps, about 1,028 instructions, only when a hold starts or the group changes. Chip load is not measured.

dsp.rationale: No DSP program, effect slot or DSP state is added. The temporary mute word uses the stock mute path.

memory.rationale: A 1,500-byte image with 44 writable bytes, zero BSS, and a 2,544-byte loader extent, with no buffers or per-track allocation.

tests.summary: Author functional report on real hardware, 6 November 2026: package 1895ceec alone ran 300 s on base 462fbd2b with the setting, hold, join and leave, audio, lamps and editing working, and rollback read back. Emulator control (18/18) and audio suites passed on 0.2.3; wider emulator results are for the 0.2.2 package. Frame load and stress not measured. See TESTING.md.

conditions.parameterExtremes: One setting, OFF or HOLD. Counted: inactive frame path (4 + 4 instructions), active frame path (12 + 9), tick transition with the longest callees, including activation updating all sixteen lamps.
conditions.parameterModulation: No parameter, lock, LFO, scene or MIDI CC reaches this code. The equivalent path is the live mute word changing underneath a hold, which adds no module work: each frame reads the word once.
conditions.modeSwitching: Activation, group change and release are the dearest transitions and are the tick bound. PROJECT, project load and MIDI mode cancel through ts_cancel, included in that bound.
conditions.maxLoad: One global instance. The bound sums mutually exclusive branches and both lamp updates, so it exceeds any single path. Measured in ot_emu with frames and both DSP cores running: 674 module instructions, 1,680 cycles (evidence/performance.json).
conditions.inputConditions: Audio content is not read; cost does not depend on the signal. Membership changes the path only through the eight-track loops, counted at their bound.

regions.name: Linked code, tables and read-only data
Writable state inside the image: session state, pointers, overlay and frame words
Loader object and seven site descriptors, rounded to 16
Largest module-owned stack path before stock replay (caller stack)

memory.conditions: ABI 8 package, zero BSS, one instance. Loader figures come from an ABI 10 probe with RUNTIME_MODULES=128. Stock callee stack, transition peaks during replacement and hardware canaries are not measured.

hardware.summary: The author ran this exact package over USB as a 300-second RAM trial on base 462fbd2b, OS 1.40C, Track Solo alone, in a disposable project. They reported the TRACK SOLO row and HOLD setting working; holding a track soloing it with playback running; taps joining and leaving once each; clean audio on release; excluded lamps dim but lit; pages, encoders, MIXER and PLAY/STOP working during a hold. Rollback was read back: phase normal, empty inventory, set identity unchanged.
limitations: Author-reported panel observations with no audio measurement or timing.
One 300-second run on one unit, alone. The USB identity does not state the model; MKII comes from earlier records of this unit.
Not tested: other modules alongside, all eight anchors, external MIDI, arranger rows, Pickup recording, K09 orderings, self-test, Keep, power cycles, MKI, the card build.

tutorial.title: Quick tutorial: audition tracks while editing
steps: Install Track Solo over USB. Open PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER, set TRACK SOLO to HOLD, close the menu, and let any stock notification clear.
Hold T2 alone for 0.5 seconds. While continuing to hold T2, press and release T3: T2 and T3 are now in the temporary group. Press T3 again to remove it.
Release T2. The underlying mute and solo state applies again. Select OFF to disable the gesture completely.

steps: Open PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER and choose HOLD for TRACK SOLO.
Close the menu, hold one TRACK button alone for 30 instrument UI ticks (about 0.5 seconds), then tap others to toggle their solo.
Release the original TRACK button to end solo; choose OFF to disable the gesture.
